name: split-button
title: Split button
description: A button with a menu of related actions attached: the main part runs the usual action, the arrow opens the others.
htmlExample:
<bef-split-button id="g1">Publish</bef-split-button>
<script type="module">
document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  onClick: () => befui.toast.success("Published"),
  actions: [
    { label: "Save as draft", onSelect: () => befui.toast.info("Saved as draft") },
    { label: "Schedule for later", onSelect: () => befui.toast.info("Scheduled") },
    {
      label: "Publish and share",
      onSelect: () => befui.toast.success("Published and shared"),
    },
  ],
};
</script>
